verdict.rationale: Square maintains a first-party GitHub repository, square/connect-api-specification, whose README points developers to pre-built clients and sample apps, which implies a downloadable machine-readable spec exists there. However, the evidence never states the format (OpenAPI/Swagger) or that the spec is current, and probes of standard OpenAPI paths on developer.squareup.com all returned 404. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the repo holds an OpenAPI/equivalent file, evidence that it is current and complete, a discoverable spec URL on the developer site, independent or hands-on corroboration.
